title: Netanyahu Associates Acknowledge Role in Setting Off Election Day Arrests
summary_full: After a historic result for Israel’s Arab-led parties, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said the vote was rigged, pointing to the detention of three opposition activists. His chief of staff has admitted being involved with the initial outreach to police.
